notes.message: --font-mono: var(--font-geist-mono) is Geist Mono (next/font/google, app/layout.tsx:11), set at runtime by next/font.

--font-sans: var(--font-sans) refers to itself, so a browser reads it as invalid and falls back to the system font. The Adapter takes the one next/font loader whose variable ends in -sans, --font-geist-sans: Geist (next/font/google, app/layout.tsx:6), the font the project loads (#125, #160).
Only the project's own CSS is read. Tailwind's default theme (its colour palette, shadows) is not carried, except its type scale and font weights, which the Text Styles hold.
fontStyle is the Figma style each weight is named by (Thin, ExtraLight, Light, Regular, Medium, SemiBold, Bold, ExtraBold, Black); not yet checked against the Geist styles Figma offers.
Multipliers are not variables: each step records its multiplier and factor in `from` (#70 §3).
